subject: general
question: Which of the following is a type of sedimentary rock?
solution:
Correct answer is __**Sandstone.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Common sedimentary rocks include **sandstone, limestone, and shale.**
 
• These rocks frequently start as **sediments carried in rivers and deposited in lakes and oceans.**
 
• When secreted, the **sediments lose water** and become cemented to form rock.
 
• Sandstone is **a clastic sedimentary rock composed mainly of sand-sized (0.0625 to 2 mm) silicate grains**.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/286337c4b082b5e8c044d3f06c7a131059c137775117b169145442ba637f45e8.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​Lignite, frequently mention to as brown coal, is **a soft brown combustible sedimentary rock that is formed from naturally compressed peat**. 
 
• **Slate** is a metamorphic rock of sedimentary origin.
 
• Granite is a **coarse-grained intrusive igneous rock composed mostly of quartz, alkali feldspar, and plagioclase**.
